resources.string: Uses Android media volume and output, including connected headphones. Phone-call earpiece controls do not apply to read-aloud.
This voice can send text to the installed speech engine provider over the internet. Select an offline voice for local synthesis.
Read-aloud is turned off. Enable it in Speech settings.
Hans reads replies using your phone’s voice. No API key is needed. Phone calls have their own voice. You can change this later in Speech settings or continue without read-aloud.
No installed voice is available for this language.
Speech could not play. Check the system voice and try the preview again.
Turn off silent or vibrate mode, turn up media volume and finish any recording or call before trying again.
Install or enable a text-to-speech engine and its language data in Android settings. You can continue setup without speech.
